Sphere-Packing-Lean port for E8Leach
====================================

Source: https://github.com/math-inc/Sphere-Packing-Lean
Commit: 1e98fb493088948ca7bbf47d7faed49cc5b39fc4 ("Add dim 8 and dim 24 formalizations"),
pinned at Lean v4.28.0 / Mathlib v4.28.0 upstream.
License: Apache License 2.0 (copy: licenses/Sphere-Packing-Apache-2.0.txt).
Copyright headers of the original files are retained. Every modified file carries the line
"-- Modified for E8Leach (Lean 4.33.1 / pinned Mathlib port, 2026-10-10); see SpherePacking/PORTING.txt."

Target environment: Lean v4.33.1, Mathlib 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474 (this project's pin).
Target scope: the import closure of SpherePacking.Dim8.MainTheorem (Viazovska's theorem in
dimension 8), plus one added compatibility module (SpherePacking/ForMathlib/QExpansionCompat.lean).
Only modules that already compile are copied here; the current list is at the end of this file.

Kinds of changes (no statement of a ported theorem was weakened; proofs only, plus the items below):
1. Proof repairs for the newer elaborator/simp:
   - `simpa ... using t` whose closing check now fails was replaced by `exact t`, or by `simpa` with
     a few extra unfolding lemmas (`Function.comp_def`, `Pi.*_def`, `Submodule.vadd_def`, ...),
     or by `convert t using n` followed by closing tactics. Choices were made by compiling
     candidates and keeping the first that removes the error.
   - Later modules use a uniform rule instead: every `simpa ... using t` becomes
     `simpa ... using! t`. Lean 4.33 closes `simpa ... using t` at reducible transparency;
     the built-in `using!` form keeps the default-transparency close of Lean 4.28, so the proof
     text is unchanged apart from the `!` (tools/bang.py in the port workspace).
   - Declarations that relied on the old definitional-unfolding behaviour are prefixed with
     `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in` (the same mechanism used
     throughout pinned Mathlib).
   - `convert` is used with `(postTransparency := .instances)` where instance-equality side goals
     appeared; this reproduces the earlier behaviour of `convert`.
2. API renames in Mathlib: `NoAtoms` -> `MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass`, `DFunLike.coe_injective'`
   -> `coe_injective`, `SlashInvariantFormClass.cuspFunction` -> `UpperHalfPlane.cuspFunction`,
   `qExpansion_add/sub/smul/eq_zero_iff` -> `ModularForm.*`, `Summable.subtype (s := _)` -> `(p := _)`,
   the new `ModularGroup.coe_S/coe_T` and `S_mul_S_eq` lemmas, `Ring.add_congr/mul_congr` (tactic
   internals in Tactic/NormNumI), `Simp.Result` field `cache`, `deriveBool` dependent match.
3. Module names: files named `Aux.lean` were renamed `Auxiliary.lean` (Lean 4.33 rejects the
   non-portable module name `Aux`); imports were updated accordingly.
4. Visibility/structure: `PeriodicSpherePacking.instFintypeNumReps'` became a reducible `def`
   (its explicit arguments cannot be inferred by instance search); `negI : Γ(2)` is defined as
   `⟨-1, _⟩` (the same element as `!![-1,0;0,-1]`).
5a. Added module `SpherePacking.ForMathlib.CancelDenomsCompat`. Three `cancel_denoms` helper
   lemmas (`mul_subst`, `cancel_factors_eq_div`, `derive_trans`) are cited by name in upstream
   proofs. In the pinned Mathlib they moved into a `meta` section of `Mathlib.Tactic.CancelDenoms`,
   so this module restates them, with the same statements and the same proofs, under the old
   `CancelDenoms` names.
5b. Level-one rank lemmas: Mathlib now states them for `(mapGL ℝ).range`, while upstream uses
   `Γ(1)`. Local `Γ(1)` versions transport them along `Γ(1) = ⊤`, using the
   `∀ G [G.HasDetOne], G = range → …` / `rintro G _ rfl` pattern.
   This affects DimensionFormulas and Dim24 …/RootlessCase/ThetaEquality.
5c. Elaboration details:
   - The Fourier transform `𝓕 f` of a plain function, and `fourierCLE ℂ E`, no longer infer their
     codomain from the argument alone. Type ascriptions were added (FourierPermutations).
   - `S * T * S` matrix entries are now computed by `rfl` and `ModularGroup.denom_apply`
     (PermJ12Regularity, dims 8 and 24).
5d. Name clash with newer Mathlib: `ModularForm.dimension_level_one` (DimensionFormulas, with the
   extra hypothesis `3 ≤ k`) clashes with Mathlib's `ModularForm.dimension_level_one` in
   `NumberTheory.ModularForms.LevelOne.DimensionFormula` as soon as both are imported. It is
   renamed `ModularForm.dimension_level_one_of_three_le` (its only use is in the same file).
   A static scan of the 2,483 declaration names of the Dim8 closure found no other clash with
   Mathlib or with `E8Leech` (2026-10-11).
5. Added module `SpherePacking.ForMathlib.QExpansionCompat`: re-proves the earlier
   `ModularFormClass.cuspFunction_apply_zero`, `qExpansion_coeff_zero` and
   `hasFPowerSeries_cuspFunction` names from the current `UpperHalfPlane` API.

Compilation options for this library (lakefile `leanOptions` and scripts/check_project.py):
  pp.unicode.fun=true, autoImplicit=false, relaxedAutoImplicit=false,
  weak.linter.style.longLine=false, weak.linter.style.longFile=1500 (the upstream lakefile options).
  scripts/check_project.py lists the 251 modules in topological order (SPL_MODULES).
  Integration build (2026-10-11): 251/251 modules, 0 errors, 66 linter warnings in 17 modules
  (style linters only; record ~/lean-build/e8leach-spl-port/integrate-build2.json).

6. Dim24 upper-bound closure (2026-10-11)
   SpherePacking.Dim24.MagicFunction.F.UpperBound and its closure (452 workspace modules, 319 beyond
   the Dim8 closure) were ported with the same options; the uniqueness part of the Leech theorem is not
   included. Manual fixes beyond the automatic simpa/option repairs:
   Dim24 port fixes (2026-10-11, session 6; record in SpherePacking/PORTING.txt when integrating):
   - Ineq2/GeOneCoeffs: set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 for the 25-case table lemma (4.33 slower whnf).
   - B/Defs/PsiExtensions: `fun_prop [hH2, hH3, hH4]` -> `fun_prop` (local hypotheses are used automatically; lists take constants only).
   - AppendixA/EisensteinSeriesBounds, BLeadingNumLowerBound/PsiCoeffMatch: Finset.antidiagonal.fst_le/snd_le -> Finset.Nat.antidiagonal.fst_lt/snd_lt (+ Nat.le_of_lt_succ / Nat.succ_le_of_lt).
   - B/PureImag: simp now normalizes conj (z^10) to (conj z)^10 first; added hpow' in that form.
   - Ineq2 DenomReduction/LowerBound, TruncAux/Denom: `lia` (grind) fails on real division; rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]; linarith.
   - Ineq2Varphi/CertAssemble: `simp [List.getElem_map]` no progress -> exact List.getElem_map _.
   - BLeadingNumLowerBound/CoeffMatchingLemmas: add BleadingCoeffs.QN to simp set (decides 0 < QN).
   - ExactTruncPosRigorous/SmallIntervalLB: goal closed only up to defeq after simp; added rfl.
   - Port target restricted to the closure of Dim24.MagicFunction.F.UpperBound (452 modules); uniqueness part (BS81 etc.) not needed.
   - Ineq2/GeOne/NumTruncBound, LeOne/TruncAux/NumTailBound/TailTermBounds: `lia` -> `linarith` (real-arithmetic chains).
   - A/DefsAux/Schwartz/I4Smooth: `simpa [hEq] using! (f.mul g).neg` -> rw [← hEq]; exact (f.mul g).neg (Pi-form Continuous.mul; simp hit non-exposed Complex.mulAux).
   - A/DefsAux/Schwartz/I6Differentiation: continuity of `coeff` by `simp only [coeff, ...]; fun_prop`.
   - F/ProfileComplex/A1: `intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const` -> root `intervalIntegrable_const` (Mathlib rename).
   - A/SpecialValues/Aux02 (l.591): `lia` (grind) fails on a nonlinear chain -> `linarith`.
   - A/Eigen/PermI56KernelSetup (l.151): `dsimp [permI5KernelMeas]` no progress on a private def -> removed (exact closes by defeq).
   - B/Eigen/PermJ5 (l.206): `lia` (grind) fails to chain integral equalities -> `rw [hpull, htoIter, hswap', hintEq]`.
   - F/Laplace/B/SubLeadingBounds/DeltaDivQLowerBound (l.66): `dist`/`‖·-·‖` no longer defeq-visible (instNorm not exposed) -> `simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ...`.
   - A/SpecialValues/EvenAProfile/Basic: same cause at two `hBall` terms -> `Filter.mem_of_superset (Filter.mem_map.mp ...)` + `simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]`; `lia` -> `rw [hEq]; exact hmem.le`; final `dist` goal -> `rw [dist_eq_norm]`.
   - A/SpecialValues/EvenAProfile/AtFour (l.146): final `dist` goal -> `rw [dist_eq_norm]` (instNorm not exposed).
   - F/Laplace/B/SubLeadingBounds/ExactTruncBound (l.422): `lia` (grind) fails to chain -> `rw [hsum_eq]; exact htri.trans hsum`.
   - A/SpecialValues/Final/DerivFour (l.125, l.168), F/Laplace/Fourier/Continuation/IntegrandSetup (l.254, preemptive): `Tendsto.eventually (ball_mem_nhds ..)` against a `‖· - l‖ < 1` goal -> `simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ...`.
   - F/Laplace/Profiles/BProfile/TailDifference (l.260): `intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const` -> `intervalIntegrable_const`.
   - A/SpecialValues/Final/DerivTwoLaurent/AvaluesConvergentRange (l.224): `lia` -> `rw [← hres']; exact hres.trans hle`.
   - A/SpecialValues/Final/DerivTwoLaurent/AvaluesEqAvaluesImpl: `simpa [Metric.mem_ball]` now needs `dist_eq_norm` (l.447); `lia` -> `rw [hnorm]; linarith [hmul]` (l.691).
   - F/Sign/SignConditions (l.64): `simp` now rewrites `↑(rexp _)` to `cexp` and leaves `mul_re` residue -> `exact Complex.re_mul_ofReal _ _`.

The full port workspace (all 829 upstream files, partially ported, with the repair tools) is kept
outside Dropbox at ~/lean-build/e8leach-spl-port; modules are moved here once they compile.

Linter warnings (2026-10-10, not yet cleaned; no errors): ForMathlib.Encard 1, Basic.SpherePacking 10, Basic.PeriodicPacking.Auxiliary 8, Basic.PeriodicPacking.Theorem22 2, Basic.PeriodicPacking.DensityFormula 3, Basic.PeriodicPacking.PeriodicConstant 2.
They are deprecations, unused-tactic notices and `Try this` suggestions introduced by the port; a cleanup pass is scheduled.

2026-10-13 local BRR extension (LPBound.lean):
  Export periodic_poisson_identity and periodic_poisson_lower_bound from the
  existing Poisson calculation, retaining the full off-diagonal sum instead of
  replacing it by the diagonal upper bound. The lower bound assumes only real,
  nonnegative Fourier transform and bounded representatives; it does not assume
  sign away from zero, separation=1, unique cover or nonempty centres.
  Existing LPBound private proofs are reused for the Fourier zero-mode bound.
  Remove redundant I suffixes on local let/have instances to satisfy the current
  Lean style linter. These changes do not alter existing public LP statements.
  The extension is compiled and audited with the current local BRR milestone;
  it has not been included in a new full clean rebuild of the entire port.
